dataset_info.summary: Recordings of people saying “Sam”, paired with the same collection's own curated negative clips rather than the shared not-wake-word pool. One row is one clip with its label. Because the negatives are adversarial rather than drawn from the shared not-wake-word pool, the false-alarm figure here is not comparable with the other wake-word boards.
dataset_info.notes: The 'Sam' wake word — real recordings in positive/ as positives and the dataset's own curated negative/ folder as hard negatives (no external negatives pool, so this is a self-contained positive-vs-hard-negative set).
